svg.title: How the Autonomous AI Coding Pipeline works
svg.desc: From labelled issue to merged pull request: Label issue ai-build, then Plan scout + planner, then Spec posted on the issue, then Failing tests then the code, then Adversarial verifier, then Checks gate tests + AI review, then Bounded fix loop, then A person merges. It has opened 200+ pull requests.
svg.text: HOW THE AUTONOMOUS AI CODING PIPELINE WORKS
Hooks the agent can't edit enforce TDD, and every loop has a hard limit and a hand-back to a person.
